data.one_liner: An easy-to-use and scrollable vertical weight slider for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable vertical slider widget specifically designed for selecting weight values. Includes a controller to manage the initial weight, minimum weight, and intervals, as well as customizable decorations.
use_when: You need a dedicated vertical slider UI component for picking weight or similar measurements.
You want support for Android, iOS, and Web platforms out of the box.
avoid_when: You need a standard horizontal slider component.
You require a complex form builder integration rather than a standalone UI widget.
strengths: Scrollable vertical interface optimized for weight input.
Supports customizable pointer decoration and indicators.
Compatible with Android, iOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Very narrow and specialized scope of functionality.
Limited built-in layout features beyond its primary use case.
